onboarding.title: Welcome to Hisab Pagar
onboarding.subtitle: Manage your staff attendance & payments offline
onboarding.phone_help: We may call you to hear your feedback and make the app better for you.

phone_prompt.title: Help us improve Hisab Pagar
phone_prompt.subtitle: Share your mobile number — we may call to hear your feedback and suggestions.

backup_reminder.title: Back up your data
backup_reminder.subtitle: Your records are saved only on this phone. Save a backup to Google Drive or WhatsApp so you never lose them.

home.title: My Staff
home.add_first_staff: Tap + to add your first staff member
home.no_active_staff_hint: Staff who left are listed below. Tap + to add new staff.

staff.name: Name
staff.week_off_hint: Tap days off — you can pick more than one
staff.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this staff member? All data will be lost.
staff.status_inactive: Inactive — kept for records, hidden from daily list
staff.contact_permission_msg: Allow contacts access to pick a staff member's name and number. You can enable it from Settings.
staff.duplicate_phone: This mobile number is already added for another staff member.
staff.joining_date_hint: Days before this date are not counted in salary.
staff.shift_hours_hint: A present day counts as this many hours
staff.late_fine_hint: Deducted each day you mark them late. Leave empty for no fine.
staff.upi_id_hint: To pay salary by UPI from the app, e.g. name@okaxis
staff.upi_invalid: Enter a valid UPI ID, e.g. name@okaxis

payment.title: Payments
payment.delete_confirm: Delete this payment? This cannot be undone.

business.name: Business Name
business.switch_description: Tap to switch or add business
business.delete_confirm: This will permanently delete this business and all its staff, attendance and records. This cannot be undone.

cashbook.add_entry_hint: Tap + to add income or expense
cashbook.delete_confirm: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reminder_notif_body: Don't forget to mark today's attendance!
settings.restore_confirm: This will replace all current data. Continue?
settings.rate_desc: Enjoying Hisab Pagar? Leave a review ⭐
settings.share_app_desc: Tell other business owners about Hisab Pagar
settings.backup_not_set: Not set up — records are only on this phone

share.message: I use Hisab Pagar to manage staff attendance (hazri) and salary. It is free and works without internet. Try it:

ai.error: Couldn't generate summary. Check your internet and try again.
ai.not_configured: AI summary isn't set up yet. Deploy the free proxy and add its URL to enable it.
ai.disclaimer: AI-generated from your data. Please verify important numbers.

first_attendance.title: Mark today's attendance for %{name}
first_attendance.subtitle: Do this every day and salary and dues are calculated automatically.
first_attendance.reminder_on: We'll remind you every day at %{time}.

drive.title: Google Drive backup
drive.restore_confirm: This will replace all data on this phone with your Google Drive backup. Continue?
drive.restore_none: No backup found in this Google account.
drive.promo_subtitle: Turn on automatic backup to your Google Drive. Staff, attendance and payments are saved every day and come back when you reinstall or change phones.
drive.onboarding_restore: Already used Hisab Pagar? Restore from Google Drive
drive.error: Google Drive backup failed. Please try again.
drive.auto_on: New entries are backed up automatically
drive.change_note: Your old backup stays in the old account. Data on this phone will be backed up to the new account.
drive.storage_error: Couldn't load storage. Tap to retry.
drive.disconnect_confirm: Automatic backup will stop. Your last backup stays in Google Drive.
drive.storage_full: Your Google storage is full. Free up space or get more storage, then tap Back up now.
drive.storage_full_paused: Google storage is full, so backups are paused
drive.scope_missing: Backup needs permission to save to your Google Drive. On the Google screen, tick the Google Drive box and then tap Continue.
drive.scope_lost: Google Drive access was turned off, so backup stopped. Tap "Connect Google Drive" and tick the Google Drive box.

app_check.title: Help us improve Hisab Pagar
app_check.body: Can Hisab Pagar check whether you also have WhatsApp, PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, OkCredit, Khatabook, Vyapar or PagarBook installed? Only these apps are checked — never your other apps, messages or data. It helps us understand how businesses pay staff and what to build next.
app_check.settings_desc: Helps us improve Hisab Pagar. You can turn it off any time.
app_check.settings_note: Only a few payment, khata and WhatsApp apps are checked — never your other apps, messages or data.

reminder.body: Tap to mark today's attendance. Salary is worked out from it.
reminder.body_day2: Day 2! Mark today's attendance so this month's salary comes out right.

checklist.salary_hint: How much each staff member is owed this month
